gap: No result ChatGPT got states, on one comparable basis, what each Outdoor 4 solar option is specified to do. Blink's own Solaris FAQ and setup guide (read 2026-11-17) name only the Outdoor 2K+ and never mention the Outdoor 4, so the '45 minutes of sun', 'up to one month' and in-app battery-status claims are stated for the Outdoor 2K+ only. Blink's only panel with published electrical specs (Solar Panel Mount: 0.8 W, 5 V/0.5 A, 3,200 mAh / 11.84 Wh 18650) is Outdoor 3rd Gen only. Wasserstein publishes no wattage or battery capacity at all.
standout_why: I compared the cited Blink Solaris FAQ (en_US faq-blink-solaris), the cited Solar Panel Mount FAQ, the Solar Panel Mount specifications page, the 'How to Power your Blink Camera' page and Wasserstein's product listing. ChatGPT wrote 'Blink confirms that Solaris works with Outdoor 4' and cited the Solaris FAQ. Today that FAQ says only 'Blink Solaris is compatible with the Blink Outdoor 2K+', and so do the en_GB FAQ and the setup guide. The Outdoor 4 appears in retail and press copy instead: Best Buy's product title, and Gadget Flow ('turns your Outdoor 4 or Outdoor 2K+ camera...'). None of the rival pages puts the options side by side or flags that every Outdoor 4 claim for Solaris comes from retail copy rather than Blink support. None says that the third-party panels publish no watts or mAh while Blink's mount publishes 0.8 W and 11.84 Wh.
decides: Solaris stays the pick for a panel that attaches to the camera, but the page should say that Blink's support pages currently document it only for the Outdoor 2K+. An Outdoor 4 owner should rely on the retailer's compatibility statement and its return window, not on the FAQ ChatGPT cited. For a separately mounted panel, Wasserstein (or a generic USB-C panel) is the only route, since the official Solar Panel Mount excludes the Outdoor 4. Neither publishes watts or battery mAh, so no output figure can be compared with Blink's 0.8 W mount.

findings.label: Compatibility stated by Blink support
findings.value: Outdoor 2K+ only; the Outdoor 4 is not mentioned
findings.note: Verbatim: 'Blink Solaris is compatible with the Blink Outdoor 2K+.' The same wording is at https://support.blinkforhome.com/en_US/blink-solaris-faq and https://support.blinkforhome.com/en_GB/blink-solaris-faq, both read 2026-11-17. This is the page ChatGPT cited for Outdoor 4 compatibility.

findings.label: Setup instructions: camera named
findings.value: Outdoor 2K+ only (remove the back cover and AA batteries, slide Solaris on, tighten the centre screw)
findings.note: Verbatim: 'remove the back cover and AA batteries from your Blink Outdoor 2K+ camera'. The guide gives no Outdoor 4 procedure.

findings.label: Compatibility in press copy
findings.source_title: Blink Solaris solar battery pack — Gadget Flow
findings.note: Gadget Flow: 'turns your Outdoor 4 or Outdoor 2K+ camera into a maintenance-free security system'; it also lists $39.99 and app battery status 'in 5% increments'. Best Buy's product title also says 'for Outdoor 4 and Outdoor 2K' (title seen in search results; the page timed out twice).

findings.label: Sunlight needed (Blink's condition)
findings.value: at least 45 minutes of direct sunlight daily
findings.note: Blink qualifies this as 'for optimal performance' and says charging depends on 'device usage, settings, and other environmental factors'. It gives no events-per-day or temperature basis, and the page describes it for the Outdoor 2K+ only.

findings.label: Backup with no sun / weather rating / height
findings.value: up to one month on its own battery; IP65 only when connected to the camera; mount up to 10 ft (3 m) high; ships 20–30% charged
findings.note: The IP65 rating is conditional ('when connected to your camera'). It attaches to the camera and cannot be mounted separately.

findings.label: Panel output and battery
findings.value: 0.8 W solar; 5 V DC 0.5 A output; one 18650 Li-ion 3.7 V 3,200 mAh (11.84 Wh)
findings.source_title: Blink Solar Panel Mount Technical Specifications — Blink Support
findings.note: The capacity in Wh comes from the FAQ (3.7 V × 3.2 Ah = 11.84 Wh). This is the only Blink solar product with published watts and Wh.

findings.label: Compatibility, temperature, cable
findings.value: Outdoor (3rd Gen) only (Outdoor 4, XT and XT2 not compatible); -4 °F to 113 °F (-20 to 45 °C); 2 ft micro-USB cable, optional 13 ft extension; IP65
findings.source_title: Blink Solar Panel Mount FAQ — Blink Support
findings.note: Verbatim: 'the Solar Mount can only be used with Blink Outdoor (3rd Gen) cameras.' 1-year limited warranty in the US.

findings.product: Wasserstein Solar Panel for Blink Outdoor 4 & 3 / XT2 / XT
